# Rosemary West & Una Meredith

- [Rosemary West](../character/rosemary-west.md) — Friend of — [Una Meredith](../character/una-meredith.md) — friend and helper · since v5  <sub>[v5 CHAPTER XXXIV. UNA VISITS THE HILL P31](../source/v05-c34.md#nw-v05-c34-p0031)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> Miss Cornelia and [Susan](../character/susan.md) share local gossip with [Anne](../character/anne.md) following her return from [Europe](../codex/places.md#europe), detailing the antics of the new [Presbyterian](../codex/factions.md#presbyterian) minister, Mr. Meredith, and his motherless children. They discuss the messy state of the manse, the children's mischief, and local church politics before Miss Cornelia departs.
>
> — v5 · CHAPTER II. SHEER GOSSIP

> [The Meredith](../codex/factions.md#the-meredith) children sit in the old [Methodist](../codex/factions.md#methodist) graveyard chatting about town gossips, buried people, and their new [Blythe](../character/blythe.md) neighbors. Drawn by a wonderful smell, they run down into [Rainbow Valley](../codex/places.md#rainbow-valley) and join the [Blythe](../character/blythe.md) children for a meal of trout. The two groups quickly become firm friends as they share stories of their lives.
>
> — v5 · CHAPTER IV. THE MANSE CHILDREN

> At the church service, [Faith](../character/faith.md) addresses the congregation to clear her father's name regarding the house-cleaning incident, explaining the mix-up in days. The following day, [Faith](../character/faith.md) dares [Walter](../character/walter.md) to ride pigs through the village streets, drawing various reactions from the villagers. Later, Miss Cornelia visits [Ingleside](../codex/places.md#ingleside) to discuss Faith's antics with [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Susan](../character/susan.md), leading to a lighthearted conversation about childhood and local town gossip.
>
> — v5 · CHAPTER XII. AN EXPLANATION AND A DARE

> [John Meredith](../character/john-meredith.md) becomes engrossed in [German](../codex/factions.md#german) theology, forgetting his parish duties and family until the wealthy and overbearing Mrs. [Alec Davis](../character/davis.md) visits the manse. Mrs. [Davis](../character/davis.md) angrily demands to adopt [Una](../character/una-meredith.md) and accuses him of neglecting his children, but he firmly refuses and sends her away. Shaken by her accusations, Mr. Meredith reflects on his shortcomings as a father and decides to seek advice from Mrs. [Blythe](../character/blythe.md) at [Ingleside](../codex/places.md#ingleside).
>
> — v5 · CHAPTER XIV. MRS. ALEC DAVIS MAKES A CALL

> Mr. Meredith observes his children during supper and reflects on Mrs. Davis's complaints about their behavior. Seeing that Mrs. [Blythe](../character/blythe.md) is away, he decides to visit the [West](../character/west.md) homestead to return a borrowed book and enjoy the company of [Rosemary](../character/rosemary-west.md) and [Ellen](../character/ellen-west.md).
>
> — v5 · CHAPTER XIV. MRS. ALEC DAVIS MAKES A CALL

> [Faith](../character/faith.md), distraught over the mocking she received at school regarding [Adam](../character/adam.md), seeks out Mrs. [Blythe](../character/blythe.md) but instead encounters [Rosemary West](../character/rosemary-west.md) in [Rainbow Valley](../codex/places.md#rainbow-valley). [Rosemary](../character/rosemary-west.md) listens sympathetically, comforts [Faith](../character/faith.md), and offers to give her a canary. Later at home, [Faith](../character/faith.md) tells her family how much she loves [Rosemary](../character/rosemary-west.md), catching her father's interest.
>
> — v5 · CHAPTER XX. FAITH MAKES A FRIEND

> [Cornelia Bryant](../character/cornelia-bryant.md) and [Susan](../character/susan.md) complain to [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) about the minister's children singing a lighthearted song in the graveyard during a [Methodist](../codex/factions.md#methodist) prayer meeting. After [Cornelia](../character/cornelia-bryant.md) brings the issue to Mr. Meredith's attention, he calls [Jerry](../character/jerry.md), [Faith](../character/faith.md), [Una](../character/una-meredith.md), and [Carl](../character/carl.md) into his study to gently reprimand them. Ashamed, the children resolve to punish themselves through their [Conduct Club](../codex/factions.md#conduct-club), while Mr. Meredith despairs over his parenting and longs for [Rosemary](../character/rosemary-west.md).
>
> — v5 · CHAPTER XXVII. A SACRED CONCERT

> [The Meredith](../codex/factions.md#the-meredith) children decide to fast all day Sunday as a self-imposed punishment for their Good-[Conduct Club](../codex/factions.md#conduct-club), but [Una](../character/una-meredith.md) faints during the evening church service from lack of food. Doctor [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) revives [Una](../character/una-meredith.md), and [Faith](../character/faith.md) explains to her father and Mrs. Clow that the children are raising themselves. Distressed by Faith's words, [John Meredith](../character/john-meredith.md) resolves to be a better father to his children, though he realizes he can never marry anyone but [Rosemary West](../character/rosemary-west.md).
>
> — v5 · CHAPTER XXVIII. A FAST DAY

> [Faith](../character/faith.md), [Carl](../character/carl.md), and [Una](../character/una-meredith.md) become terrified in [Rainbow Valley](../codex/places.md#rainbow-valley) when they mistake Mrs. [Stimson](../character/stimson.md)—who is crawling on the [Bailey](../codex/places.md#bailey) garden dyke with white sheets on her shoulders looking for a knitting needle—for the ghost of [Henry Warren](../character/henry-warren.md). Terrified, the Meredith children sprint to [Ingleside](../codex/places.md#ingleside), where [Rosemary West](../character/rosemary-west.md) and [Susan Baker](../character/susan.md) soothe them. [Susan](../character/susan.md) investigates with a pitchfork and returns to explain the embarrassing truth, prompting the children to retreat home in shame.
>
> — v5 · CHAPTER XXX. THE GHOST ON THE DYKE

> [Mary Vance](../character/mary-vance.md) gossips with [Faith](../character/faith.md) and [Una](../character/una-meredith.md) about local rumors, including [Rosemary](../character/rosemary-west.md) West's refusal to marry their father and Carl's prank involving an eel and Mrs. [Carr](../character/carr.md). After Mr. Meredith hears about the prank, he confronts [Carl](../character/carl.md) and intends to whip him, but finds himself unable to go through with the punishment when he looks into Carl's eyes. [Una](../character/una-meredith.md) later witnesses her father's deep anguish alone in his dark study.
>
> — v5 · CHAPTER XXXIII. CARL IS—NOT—WHIPPED

> Determined to make her unhappy father happy, [Una Meredith](../character/una-meredith.md) visits her late mother's gray dress in the spare room before walking to the [West](../character/west.md) house to speak with [Rosemary West](../character/rosemary-west.md). Thinking stepmothers are cruel, [Una](../character/una-meredith.md) selflessly begs [Rosemary](../character/rosemary-west.md) to marry her father and promises that the children will behave. [Rosemary](../character/rosemary-west.md) reassures [Una](../character/una-meredith.md), writes a letter agreeing to meet [John Meredith](../character/john-meredith.md), and sends [Una](../character/una-meredith.md) back to the manse to deliver it.
>
> — v5 · CHAPTER XXXIV. UNA VISITS THE HILL
